summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice to the Market announcing that its Board of Directors approved hiring Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu as independent auditor for fiscal years 2026-2028, replacing KPMG, which agreed with the change. Deloitte will begin with Q3 2026 quarterly information. This is a routine auditor change disclosure in the context of a shareholding structure change, not a special situation event. No deal terms, prices, or shareholder actions are involved. The filing is a standard regulatory update with no investment or restructuring mechanics; the only notable element is the reference to a governance arrangement change, but no details are provided. What to watch: any subsequent filings detailing the control structure change, but this filing itself is not a special situation.
